newsitem.title: CHINA: China domestic TV prices hit bottom - paper.
newsitem.headline: China domestic TV prices hit bottom - paper.

text.p: China's colour television producers, embroiled in a vicious price war since April, are unable to cut prices further, the People's Daily Overseas Edition said on Monday.
Prices of Chinese televisions had been slashed by about 20 percent since April but had now hit bottom, the newspaper quoted analysts from Ministry of Electronics Industry as saying.
The intense competition during the first half of the year had sparked a revival of the market, it said.
Chinese television makers were selling up to 99 percent of the units they produced, it said but gave no further details.
